title: New combinations from your own closet
description: Suggestions use the clothes you have and let you pin a base you like.

blocks.text: The review’s author values combinations made from clothes already bought. That is a confirmed value; there is no complaint about an imposed shopping list in this quote.

quote.text: I tried two other apps and numerous clothing delivery services that were not useful at all. I love this app because it gives me ideas of outfits with the things I already own. Can't say enough great things about it.

blocks.text: Pin the base and swap a part

Offer several outfits from a person’s own catalog only. Let a base that works be saved and the shoes or the top layer be swapped. If an item is temporarily unavailable, leave it out of today’s selection without deleting it from the closet.
How to tell whether the suggestions helped
Look at which suggestions a person edited and actually used. The number of collages generated does not on its own show whether getting dressed got easier.
